method: Session archaeology, interactive: the 64 upload sessions from data/sessions.json (7-day upload-gap rule; upload dates are NOT recording dates) as an explorable timeline. gaps[] are the 60 inter-session silences in days; clusters[] are 'activity seasons' - consecutive sessions grouped while the separating silence is <= 90 days, a computed browsing convention, not an artist fact. loudest/deepest_cut are the session's max/min play counts (2026-10-11 snapshot); collaborators are w//ft. title credits parsed by the shared rule (producers excluded). Titles and metadata only - never lyrics, never invented bio facts.
